column1: Jeremy Pena leads the slate with a strong track record of consistency, recording a hit in nearly 80% of games and enjoying the leadoff spot against a lefty he matches up well with. Luis Arraez is also a reliable option at home, offering steady contact skills and a favorable matchup. Elly De La Cruz, Xavier Edwards, and Yandy Diaz round out the top choices, but Pena’s combination of recent form and reliability stands out for Beat The Streak.
